observation: Round 2 moved the proxy 0.742 -> 0.753 (accept) and correspondence_f1@15 0.535 -> 0.554 while depth_nan_ratio (0.1115) and sam_fill_rate (0.743) stayed flat, so the gain again came from detection and the extra permissiveness (binary 108 / oblique 41 / inter_radius 0.08) did NOT produce spurious lines: the round-2 detected_lines show exactly one red/green oblique pair per ring column for nine columns (x~360 ... x~2295), each pair confined to its own 240 px column, and initial_prompt_points shows the nine real midpoints locked on the two staggered K rows (y~1204 even, y~1636 odd) with det_n_points 10. The round-2 exit condition for backing off (det_n_points > 10 or det_y_std drifting from ~215) therefore did not fire. The single remaining defect is unchanged: ring 0 (x~120) is still an assumed centre at y~1123 (green diamond), ~80 px (40 cm) above the even-row K position, with no oblique segment anywhere in x 0-240. In the outlier map that column is the scan edge: the sam_depth_input shows a NaN strip along x<40 and the outlier speckle in x 60-240 is far sparser than in any other column, so its faint joint trace never accumulates 100 px of pixels connected within maxLineGap 28 even at Hough 41 / binary 108. The mis-set K centre propagates to the shifted K/A stack in ring 0 in segmentation_results and to the grey/unsupported patch and red boundary runs along the left edge of the SC correspondence overlay. The dense scanner column (x~1200-1450), which produced the bridged mid-row line in the anchor at maxLineGap 40, has been clean for two rounds at maxLineGap 28.
rule: Ontology d7 (m_line_yield low AND fallback triggered -> stage_4_detection.f_missing_lines) localised to one low-density edge column, with upstream d6 (f_joint_oversmoothed) already treated in-bounds (inter_radius at its 0.08 maximum). Sanctioned remediation r_relax_hough lists three levers: lower oblique threshold, lower minLineLength, or raise maxLineGap toward the tunnel prior (T1/T2 prior oblique maxLineGap = 40). minLineLength is not exposed; threshold and binary threshold are nearly exhausted; maxLineGap is the one lever not yet used in the relaxing direction and is exactly the mechanism that lets sparse collinear speckle chain into a >=100 px segment. Experiences section 5: consistency with ring count is what matters -- two rounds show 10/10 columns with regular spacing and no f_spurious_lines, so the r_tighten_hough branch is not indicated. Section 7 tuning order: SAM geometry (y_bounds) is still left alone because detection is not yet fully real (fallback 0.1); unfolding is frozen (stage1_unlocked false) and denoising stays at tunnel priors (section 4) since retention 0.77 / NaN 0.11 / residual 1.5 cm are healthy.
failure_mode: stage_4_detection.f_missing_lines confined to ring 0 (x~120, scan-edge column with the lowest outlier-map density): the faint joint trace cannot reach the oblique HoughLinesP vote / binarisation / gap-bridging criteria, so the K centre is assumed ~80 px above the staggered even row, propagating to stage_5_segmentation.f_crop_offset for one ring (shifted K/A stack, unsupported boundaries at the left map edge).
rationale: Final-round push aimed only at the edge column, keeping every structural choice that has held for two rounds (unfolding and denoising frozen, inter_radius 0.08, one oblique pair per column). Enhancing: curvature_threshold 0.0004 -> 0.0003 (bound minimum) so that even fewer joint-adjacent high-curvature points are absorbed into smooth-surface upsampling, preserving the depth step that the outlier enhancement keys on; this is the last in-bounds analogue of r_lower_depth_threshold and its previous step cost nothing in NaN (0.1110 -> 0.1115). Detecting: binary_threshold 108 -> 100 (bound minimum) and hough_threshold_oblique 41 -> 40 (bound minimum) to let the weakest edge-column pixels survive binarisation and vote; maxLineGap_oblique 28 -> 36, a deliberate but bounded increase (15% of the 240 px column pitch, still below the anchor's 40 that produced a bridged line in the dense scanner column) so sparse collinear speckle in x 60-240 can chain into a 100 px segment while a segment still cannot span two columns. To offset the lower binary threshold, hough_threshold_horizontal 70 -> 80 so horizontal fallback lines at the cable-bracket rows (y~450/880/1960/2400) and margins do not multiply; horizontals are fallback-only and none currently contribute to prompts. Expected GT-free signals: det_fallback_ratio 0.1 -> 0.0 with det_n_points 10 and the x~120 midpoint landing near y~1204 (even row), correspondence_f1@15 rising above 0.554, sam_ontology_divergence falling as ring 0's K/A stack aligns, sam_fill_rate flat (~0.743), depth_nan_ratio ~0.112, det_y_std ~215 px preserved. Failure signature to watch: det_n_points > 10 or an off-row midpoint in the dense x~1325 column would indicate the wider gap re-enabled bridging (f_spurious_lines / f_pattern_mismatch); in that case round 2 (maxLineGap 28) remains the better configuration and should be selected.
